description: Subcomponent of `v-heatmap-legend` that renders a single threshold cell.

props.bucketIndex: Index of the threshold bucket whose color fills the cell.
props.color: Fill color. Ignored when **bucket-index** is set.
props.disabled: Fills the cell with the empty color.

slots.default: Slot used to render custom content inside the legend cell via a `<foreignObject>`.
